name: Corduroy
description: Wide ribs with a narrow channel between them - nearly solid, but not quite.

code.style: --rule: ( --ang: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(@var(--ang), #000 0 22%, transparent 22% 28%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(@var(--ang), #000 0 22%, transparent 22% 28%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
